{{Image Wanted}}

'''Avatar Awards''' are items that the player can unlock for use with their Xbox LIVE Avatar or PlayStation Home character by completing various challenges in ''[[Red Dead Redemption]]''.

==Awards==
{|style="vertical-align:top; background: black;" class="wikitable"
!Avatar Award
!Location/Condition
|-
|'''Black Rockstar Logo T-Shirt (Men)'''
|Found in a chest in the attic of the [[Safehouses|safehouse]] in [[Beecher's Hope]].
|-
|'''Black Rockstar Logo T-Shirt (Women)'''
|Found in a chest in the attic of the [[Safehouses|safehouse]] in [[Beecher's Hope]].
|-
|'''Black on Red RDR Logo T-Shirt (Men)'''
|Found in a chest in a burnt down cabin at [[Riley's Charge]] in [[New Austin]].
|-
|'''Black on Red RDR Logo T-Shirt (Women)'''
|Found in a chest in a burnt down cabin at [[Riley's Charge]] in [[New Austin]].
|-
|'''Sombrero'''
|By shooting the hat off of someone's head without killing them.
|-

|Load a completed Single Player save after February 4, 2011.
|-

==Notes==
*Details of the contest that unlocked the Gentleman's Attire, Lady's Finery, and Posse T-Shirts on February 4, 2011 are available in a [http://www.rockstargames.com/newswire/article/13501/the-red-dead-redemption-rockstar-xp-challenge-has-officially-bee.html Rockstar Newswire article]. The article includes images of each outfit as well.
